input.source: user-provided lawful dump, kept outside git

X0.note: User-provided external retail XEX hash and title identity verified; no game binary or assets are tracked

X1.note: SDK v0.10.0 is pinned; eighteen live-memory-derived function entries have focused static regressions. ReXGlue codegen and Linux AMD64 build now accept the 68-byte 0x82341198 dispatcher; its runtime execution and the broader PPC/import/lowering report remain open.

X2.note: The plugin-enabled Linux AMD64 probe verified the retail VdEnableRingBufferRPtrWriteBack call with physical address 0x17AF403C and block-size log2 6. The GPU worker advanced the big-endian readback at descriptor+0x3C through values 25, 49, and 73; exact-XEX helper 0x823B2920 reads that +0x3C field. Earlier pristine probes watched the distinct descriptor+0x00 word, object+0x2ABD predicate, current KTHREAD+0x58 and object+13432; helper 0x823B33A0 was not entered, and the timeout helper 0x823BA9C8 traps when object+13432 is null. The 2026-10-24 exact-XEX Linux/GDB follow-up confirms source-0 retail callback 0x823B37B8 and 3,231 writes toggling the watched predicate byte between 0x04 and 0x14 via 0x823A4E48/0x823A4908. A separate 20-second Linux/GDB run with the recorded host executable/runtime/plugin hashes logged at least three source-0 callbacks entering 0x823A4640. Four sampled deferred-handler entries had queue read/write indexes 0/0 and a zero first record. Six sampled software-queue helper entries observed predicate values 0x00 then 0x14; retail predicate 0x823A0310 tests mask 0x02, clear in those samples. This separates source-0 callback delivery from software-queue completion and does not identify the missing completion producer or prove frontend progress. The earlier retained Linux log and descriptor+0 watch did not establish the EVENT_WRITE_SHD destination; a later plugin-enabled run (evidence/xbox360_event_write_ring_head_20261024.json) records per-packet writes to guest destination 0x17AF4000 and head-word progression 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 0xB, 0xD, 0xF, corresponding to the previously identified descriptor backing at 0xB7AF4000. This resolves the destination observation but not software-queue completion or the missing predicate bit 0x02 producer. A controlled SDL/uinput run (evidence/xbox360_linux_xam_input_routing_20261024.json) confirms Start and A states reach retail XamInputGetState user 0; inputs did not advance the frontend. The guest wait cause and menu progress remain open. Before the latest controlled launches, unused ReXGlue xenia_memory_* shared-memory objects consumed 4.7 GiB of /dev/shm; unreferenced current-user objects were removed before subsequent runs. In the exact 30-second run, two relative shader-cache directory opens failed with no VFS device 205 ms after the first readback; they do not explain that first black frame, and later shader-cache effects remain unknown. The 60-second exact Linux/GDB follow-up sampled 27 entries of retail helper 0x823B33A0 through call index 1500: software queue tail object+0x2A9C rose from 3 to 3003, while global 0x831B3820 remained 0 and the 1,624 observed predicate-byte writes were only 0x04/0x14. Static XEX code sets mask 0x02 only when VdIsHSIOTrainingSucceeded reports false; both the pinned ReXGlue stub and upstream Xenia return success (1), so this is expected retail gating and should not be forced. The separate software-queue consumer/head and predicate-bit 0x02 producer remain unresolved.

X3.note: Process 2 Linux evidence reports 1,828 retail PM4 packets, two guest swaps, 48 submitted retail point-list draws, and two Vulkan frame submissions. The exact-XEX Linux/GDB run recorded 161 draw submit entries and 161 accepted source-0/sample-0 Copy/Convert entries, but the retail 1280x720 A2B10G10R10 readback has zero non-black RGB pixels (FNV-1a B161DE6EEC272325). After clearing stale ReXGlue shared-memory objects, a fresh direct Linux run reproduced the same black retail readback. A separate magenta fragment-output diagnostic produced 518,400 non-black pixels (FNV-1a DA74DA070BC0D725), confirming the diagnostic raster/presenter/readback path; it is synthetic and not retail parity. Later 3-draw batches still fail the target/scissor match against PM4_XE_SWAP. Android readback is also black. Visible retail output and scene parity remain unverified. A 30-second Linux rerun with the exact host executable from the locked P1 evidence and Process 2 PR #2161 commit 8541089b produced byte-identical black readback (FNV-1a B161DE6EEC272325); repeated 3-draw batches still reject the target/scissor match. With that exact executable/plugin pair, a synthetic magenta control read back 518,400 nonblack pixels and had no 3-draw target/scissor rejection; this confirms diagnostic draw/presenter/readback coverage only, not retail parity. A later 60-second run using P2 diagnostic plugin SHA 54348dd521b97b15be963d0b9f680172dbfb83c3ef5f2fbb979f618dc9c32aaa with debug logging and no input recorded 3,010 three-draw refresh failures. The first was draw 1 sample count 1 versus frame sample count 4; both reported surfaces share color base 0, depth base 720, color format 1, and 1280x720 extent, while pitch differs (640 for draw 0, 1280 for draw 1). No shader/resource readiness diagnostic tokens appeared before this rejection, and the raw readback remains all black. This identifies the first rejection gate for this plugin build; it does not establish the correct pitch, shader translation, frontend output, or race progress.

X4.note: The user confirmed that the original game loading screen appeared during an earlier ReXGlue Xbox run, but its exact process/build hash was not recorded. In the current controlled Linux run, callbacks and retail Vulkan submissions occur but the readback is entirely black. Four loose-file probes for menu_background.xml failed. The big-endian index of PakFiles/Menu_Background.bff is verified: 57 bounded members include menu_background.sgx/.enx and textures, but no menu_background.xml. The misses do not prove a fatal VFS problem or show whether the game opens this archive. The main menu, visible retail frame, and offline race remain unverified. A controlled 2026-10-24 filtered uinput test confirms Start/A return through retail XamInputGetState for guest user 0, but these inputs did not advance the single-draw frontend. In the same retail run, four attempts to open menu_background.xml under the instances/static scene paths returned 0xc000000f; the archive index only proves Menu_Background.bff contains SGX/ENX and texture members, not the XML or fatality of the miss.

X5.note: No SHIFT Xbox runtime execution on target architectures

X6.note: Source audit found a Vulkan 1.1 path but three optional feature bits are hard requirements; device feature probe and retail draw/present proof are pending
